purpose: One full accuracy-first NLM2 training run combining the previous curated curriculum with 100 advanced Arabic-English examples. Expanded coverage includes triangles and every common polygon family (2D and star/self-intersecting polygons), circles and conics, quadrilaterals, polyhedra and solids, polygon algorithms and game-engine geometry, advanced Python, browser APIs, pixels/colors/computer-vision foundations, Arabic diacritics/grammar, and strict developer requirement adherence. Train one enlarged model (embedding 96, hidden 512), 20 epochs, then mirror and verify every trained weight on GitHub and Android asset. Add ten accuracy/anti-hallucination lesson examples (geometry, logic, Python, identity-vs-equality, RGB/pixels, relativity, refusal to fabricate, and instruction-following).
scope: Arabic letters vowels shadda tanween and sentence structure
Requirement filtering and no unrequested additions
corpus: curated-only; exclude personal-memory and unrelated chat JSONL; no offensive-language filtering
training_mode: one full training run on combined corpus including 10 new lessons; 20 epochs; no APK build
